description: This source file implements utility functions for converting between PyTorch tensors and NumPy arrays, including support for CUDA arrays and handling of NumPy's array interface. It also contains checks for NumPy support and workarounds for known NumPy bugs related to DLPack.

methods.name: tensor_to_numpy
methods.description: Converts a PyTorch tensor to a NumPy array, with checks for support and optional forcing.

methods.name: tensor_from_numpy
methods.description: Creates a PyTorch tensor from a NumPy array, handling array interface details and dtype conversions.

methods.name: is_numpy_available
methods.description: Checks if NumPy is available and initialized in the environment.

methods.name: is_numpy_int
methods.description: Checks if a PyObject is a NumPy scalar of integer type.

methods.name: is_numpy_scalar
methods.description: Checks if a PyObject is a NumPy scalar of any supported scalar type.

methods.name: is_numpy_dlpack_deleter_bugged
methods.description: Indicates if the NumPy DLPack deleter bug workaround is active.

methods.name: validate_numpy_for_dlpack_deleter_bug
methods.description: Detects NumPy version and sets a workaround flag for known DLPack deleter bugs.
